purpose: Define what a source-document census entry may and may not do before content extraction.

rules.name: label_only_until_frozen
rules.rule: A document listed on a source page may be entered as a label-only census row before URL freezing; it may not be summarized or quoted.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: treating a source-page document label as a known document content claim

rules.name: url_freeze_before_content
rules.rule: Document content extraction requires official URL capture, content hash where feasible, access timestamp, document class, and privacy scan plan.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: unverifiable extraction from moving URLs or unofficial mirrors

rules.name: privacy_scan_before_summary
rules.rule: No document summary may be public until reviewer confirms whether it contains civilian names, minors, witnesses, survivors, families, confidential informants, protected health information, or other high-risk identifiers.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: public-record-display harm to civilians and families

rules.name: document_class_is_not_claim_power
rules.rule: Document class controls evidence weight and review path; it does not by itself assert misconduct, liability, settlement amount, officer identity, or current status.

rules.name: person_records_still_forbidden
rules.rule: Officer, civilian, witness, victim, plaintiff, and family-member entities may not be extracted from DOJ documents in rev0004.
